name: Lemonless
description: Buy smart. Stay lemonless. Used-car verdicts you can check. TypeScript owns every number; AI review may choose the shopper action only inside hard gates. Insufficient evidence yields a withheld verdict with a concrete reason.

tools.name: deal_radar
tools.description: Scan current listings for one make and model. Returns deal scores from comparable asking prices in that result set. Does not spend a credit. Recalls and fuel are not included.

tools.name: full_report
tools.description: Full Lemonless analysis for one VIN or listing URL. Every response includes Proof of AI: which numbers came from code, which gates ran, and which AI review steps ran.

tools.name: POST /api/v1/report
tools.description: Same full report as MCP full_report over plain HTTP with an API key.
